title: Layer cycle between core, ui
evidence: core → ui (2 edges, back edge): packages/core/src/leak.ts → packages/ui/src/Button.tsx, packages/core/src/leak.ts → packages/ui/src/index.ts; ui → core (3 edges): packages/ui/src/Button.tsx → packages/core/src/index.ts, packages/ui/src/Button.tsx → packages/core/src/math.ts, packages/ui/src/Button.tsx → packages/core/src/util/strings.ts
why: Layers that depend on each other are no longer layers.
fix: Remove the back edges listed first; they are the cheapest to cut.

title: apps/web/src/main.tsx exports 1 unused symbol
why: Exports nobody uses are dead weight and widen the module's surface.
fix: Remove them, or drop the export keyword if they are used locally.
